meanings.translation: alone; by oneself; on one's own

examples.text: Em scismar — sósinho — á noite — / Mais prazer encontro eu lá; / Minha terra tem palmeiras, / Onde canta o Sabiá.
examples.ref: 1846, Gonçalves Dias, “Canção do exilio [The song of exile]”, in Primeiros cantos: peosias, 1st edition, Rio de Janeiro: Typographia Universal de Laemmert, page 10:
examples.english: When ruminating — alone — at night — / I find more pleasure there; / My land has palm trees, / where the Thrush sings.
examples.translation: When ruminating — alone — at night — / I find more pleasure there; / My land has palm trees, / where the Thrush sings.

examples.text: O marquez tinha ido sósinho para França. Fôra, ao que se dizia, buscar a filha ao Sacré-Cœur.

examples.english: The marquess had gone to France alone. He’d gone, supposedly, to fetch his daughter from the Sacré-Cœur.
examples.translation: The marquess had gone to France alone. He’d gone, supposedly, to fetch his daughter from the Sacré-Cœur.

examples.text: — Ai! volto, volto... Não posso deixar sózinha a mãe do meu homem, que tem oitenta annos e está entrevada.
examples.ref: 1900, Eça de Queiroz, chapter V, in A illustre Casa de Ramires, 1st edition, Porto: Livraria Chardron, page 239:
examples.english: “Oh! I’ll go back, yes... I can’t leave my man’s mother, who’s eighty years old and paralysed, by herself.
examples.translation: “Oh! I’ll go back, yes... I can’t leave my man’s mother, who’s eighty years old and paralysed, by herself.

examples.text: No momento actual, não era possivel ao Brasil vencer sosinho as suas difficuldades financeiras, nem lhe será possivel.
examples.ref: 1930 March 15, “Os interesses do Brasil sacrificados pelas agitações estereis [Brazil’s interests sacrificed by uselees commotion]”, in A Noite, volume XX, number 6583, Rio de Janeiro, page 1:
examples.english: Currently, it was not possible for Brazil to overcome its financial difficulties by itself, nor will it be possible.
examples.translation: Currently, it was not possible for Brazil to overcome its financial difficulties by itself, nor will it be possible.

examples.text: Impossivel dar cabo daquella praga. Estirou os olhos pela campina, achou-se isolado. Sózinho num mundo coberto de pennas, de aves queriam comel-o.
examples.ref: 1938, Graciliano Ramos, “O mundo coberto de pennas [The world covered in feathers]”, in Vidas Seccas [Barren Lives], Rio de Janeiro: Livraria José Olympio Editora, page 174:
examples.english: It was impossible to put an end to that pest. He looked over the plains, found himself isolated. Alone in a world covered in feathers, in birds that sought to eat him.
examples.translation: It was impossible to put an end to that pest. He looked over the plains, found himself isolated. Alone in a world covered in feathers, in birds that sought to eat him.

examples.text: Uma canção dizendo tudo a ela / Que ainda estou sozinho, apaixonado
examples.ref: 1969, Caetano Veloso, “Objeto Não Identificado”, in Caetano Veloso, Philips Records:
examples.english: A song telling her everything / That I’m still lonely, in love
examples.translation: A song telling her everything / That I’m still lonely, in love
